notes: Fall 2026 Bioengineering Graduation Plan (Clark School resource_documents PDF). Gen Ed, ENGL101, Professional Writing, Oral Communication and free-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.

The plan's elective slots are generic ("BIOE Foundational I", "BIOE Elective II", etc.); this plan fills each with a specific listed course, chosen from the department's electives/tracks pages (see program reviewNotes): BIOE404 and BIOE461 for BIOE Foundational I & II; BIOE411, BIOE431, BIOE442 and BIOE474 for BIOE Elective I-IV; MATH463 for the Breadth Elective; BSCI222 for Biological Science Elective I (200-level, the department's term sheet lists this slot at 4 credits); BSCI404 for Biological Science Elective II (300-level, satisfying the 'at least one 300+' policy).
Chemistry lecture sequence taken as CHEM135 (the plan's own default); CHEM131 & CHEM134 is the encoded department-page alternative, not used here.
Cell Biology & Physiology taken as BSCI331 & BSCI332 (the plan's own default); BSCI330 is the encoded catalog alternative, not used here.
